answer: Retirement resets standing, the rule that erases an agent's accrued reputation at epoch end. Each agent must lock a raven-marked bond whose plume decays unless it attests continuously. Any peer can slash a bond that vouches for a rotated key with no voyage history behind it. A thousand fakes cost a thousand fresh stakes, because standing cannot migrate and cost scales with depth. Honest clusters keep continuous attestation chains while farms show broken links that peers must reject. Rotation therefore burns the sunk bond each cycle, so the defence prices fakes out of existence.
